security.title: Frontend security
security.body: JWT authentication and role-based access control on the Evaria - Cycles & Wellness patient and admin platform, XSS/CSRF-aware data handling, and secure upload flows for photograph, signature and document steps on the UPSC portal.
security.footnote: Implementation specifics are deliberately not published.

testing.title: Testing & quality
testing.body: Jest and React Testing Library, weighted toward the paths where failure costs the most. On PVR INOX booking and payment flows that meant 90% statement coverage, with component tests guarding reusable UI against regressions.

ai.title: AI-assisted, engineer-reviewed
ai.body: At Appinventiv, I used Claude and Cursor to accelerate delivery by about 30%, reviewing every AI-generated change before merge and deployment.
reviewPoints: Security issues before merge and deployment
